us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: U.S. airlines recover after nationwide ground stop cancels thousands of flights
bullets: More than 2,000 flights were canceled after the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years.
Airlines warned disruptions and cancellations could continue through Saturday.
The outage stranded travelers and disrupted some professional and college sports travel.

articles.title: FAA lifts nationwide flight halt after air-traffic technology outage
bullets: The FAA lifted the nationwide ground stop Friday evening.
Transportation officials cited outdated air-traffic control technology as part of the problem.
JetBlue and other airlines warned of continued knock-on delays.

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin plan joint meeting at APEC in Shenzhen
bullets: The White House said the three leaders plan to meet next week.
The meeting would occur alongside the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China.
AP described it as unprecedented for the three nuclear powers’ leaders.

articles.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor race
bullets: NPR reported Kreiss-Tomkins won the Alaska governor’s race.
The result replaces a Republican governor in Alaska.
The race was called in post-midterm vote counting.

articles.title: Savannah Guthrie renews NBC News contract after 15 years
bullets: Guthrie extended her NBC News contract, AP reported.
She will continue as a prominent face of NBC’s Today program.
The agreement follows more than 15 years at the network.

articles.title: Israeli drone strike kills two Palestinians in Gaza
bullets: AP reported an Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in Gaza.
The story was part of AP’s latest Middle East updates.
The report came amid continued regional tensions.

articles.title: Zelenskyy says proposed European security framework could help Putin
bullets: Zelenskyy criticized a new European security framework floated by the U.S.
He said similar ideas had previously been raised by Putin.
The remarks came amid ongoing Russia-Ukraine diplomacy.

articles.title: UN chief urges drastic emissions cuts at climate summit
bullets: António Guterres called for immediate and drastic fossil-fuel emissions cuts.
He warned against catastrophic climate impacts without faster action.
The remarks came at his final climate summit, AP reported.

articles.title: U.S., China and Russia leaders set for rare APEC-side meeting
bullets: Trump, Xi and Putin are expected to meet in Shenzhen next week.
The summit brings 21 economies to China’s technology hub.
The meeting could dominate global diplomatic attention.

articles.title: Inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok
bullets: The inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia was scheduled for November 14.
Bangkok, Thailand hosted the new regional contest.
The event appeared in global day-of-news summaries.

articles.title: Modi flags off Bengaluru–Madgaon Vande Bharat Express
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off the Bengaluru–Madgaon Vande Bharat Express.
He also inaugurated four redeveloped railway stations in Karnataka.
The update appeared in Indian Express live coverage.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu limits rice and dal stocks as prices soar
bullets: Tamil Nadu set limits on rice and dal stocks, Indian Express reported.
The move followed rising prices for key staples.
The measure was reported in live national updates.

articles.title: India says it hopes Pakistan attends SCO meeting in Delhi
bullets: A minister said India hopes Pakistan will attend the SCO meeting in Delhi.
The Hindu carried the item in its November 14 headlines.
The issue concerns regional diplomacy and multilateral engagement.

articles.title: U.S. assures India comparative edge under trade deal
bullets: Indian Express reported U.S. assurances tied to a trade deal.
The item was listed among November 14 front-page headlines.
The issue relates to India-U.S. trade negotiations.
articles.source: The Indian Express / NEXT IAS roundup

articles.title: Yes Bank asks Supreme Court to review AT1 bond ruling
bullets: Yes Bank filed a Supreme Court review petition, Reuters reported.
The case concerns ₹8,415 crore of additional tier-1 bonds.
Financial Express carried the Reuters item in its November 14 edition.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and market-impact stories

articles.title: Nvidia slide weighs on tech stocks after Jensen Huang exit
bullets: Reuters reported major U.S. indexes fell as investors assessed Huang’s exit.
Technology shares were the biggest drag on the market.
Nvidia uncertainty continued to ripple through AI and chip stocks.

articles.title: Nasdaq falls as chip stocks give back gains
bullets: CoinWorldCap reported the Nasdaq fell 0.91% on November 14 market coverage.
Chip shares broadly gave back gains during the session.
The move followed renewed volatility in AI-related stocks.

articles.title: AMD drops sharply amid AI-stock volatility
bullets: AMD fell about 8.8%, among the steepest large-cap declines reported.
The drop was linked to renewed volatility across AI stocks.
The move came after a sharp prior run-up in the shares.

articles.title: Cerebras jumps after raising revenue forecast and signing Microsoft
bullets: Cerebras rose more than 11%, Reuters reported.
The company raised its 2026 revenue forecast.
It also signed Microsoft as a customer.

articles.title: Steris gains after Jefferies upgrade
bullets: Steris rose 4.29% after a Jefferies upgrade, WiseView reported.
Jefferies moved the stock to buy from hold.
The upgrade cited stronger earnings-per-share growth ahead.

articles.title: Nvidia leadership crisis raises questions for AI supply chain
bullets: AP said Huang’s exit could affect export policy and the AI supply chain.
Lawmakers are pushing for tighter technology-export restrictions.
The episode comes before Trump’s planned China visit.

articles.title: Flight disruptions hit airlines and travel-dependent businesses
bullets: Airlines worked to recover from the nationwide ground stop.
More than 2,000 cancellations disrupted travelers and operations.
Sports teams and other organizations scrambled for transportation.

articles.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage
bullets: Microsoft said services were fully restored after hours of disruption.
The company said there was no indication of malicious activity.
The outage highlighted business reliance on major cloud platforms.

articles.title: Advent revives sale process for Singapore tutoring chain
bullets: Axios reported Advent International revived a sale process for The Learning Lab.
The Singapore tutoring chain could fetch $400 million to $500 million.
Axios attributed the valuation to Bloomberg reporting.

articles.title: BYD expands luxury car push with Denza launch in India coverage
bullets: Financial Express highlighted BYD’s luxury-car expansion through Denza.
The item appeared in the November 14 Bengaluru edition.
The launch reflects BYD’s continued premium EV strategy.

articles.title: Microsoft restores services after global outage
bullets: Microsoft reported full restoration after an hourslong global outage.
The company said it saw no sign of a cyberattack.
The disruption affected communications and technology platforms worldwide.

articles.title: Nvidia scandal intensifies U.S.-China AI rivalry
bullets: AP said Nvidia’s crisis is heightening U.S.-China AI tensions.
Lawmakers are pressing for tougher technology-export controls.
The issue comes ahead of Trump’s meeting with Xi.

articles.title: FAA outage renews scrutiny of aging air-traffic technology
bullets: Transportation officials pointed to outdated air-traffic control technology.
The nationwide ground stop halted travel across the U.S.
The disruption caused widespread cancellations and operational delays.

articles.title: Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas as possible successor, report says
bullets: A news roundup cited Reuters and other outlets on Nvidia’s CEO search.
Arm CEO Rene Haas was reported as a potential successor target.
The report followed Jensen Huang’s resignation from Nvidia.

articles.title: Cerebras raises 2026 revenue forecast and signs Microsoft customer deal
bullets: Cerebras raised its 2026 revenue forecast, Reuters reported.
The chip and cloud company signed Microsoft as a customer.
Shares jumped more than 11% after the update.
